summary:
Frontend-only E2E test of iteration 5 — 7 NEW/EXTENDED flows: MetaGraph, Ontology Designer gitops lifecycle, Impact (blast/upstream/what-if), Reports scheduling, Collaboration MissingBackendState, Brand editor + theme contrast + terminology, Time Travel (as-of/compare/playback + snapshots). ALL 7 FLOWS PASS. No blocking bugs.

META-GRAPH (/meta-graph): header grouped list rendered 75 metagraph-type-item entries under metagraph-types-list; metagraph-search, graph-canvas, metagraph-show-counts/-properties/-indexes all present. Clicking a type populated metagraph-inspector. metagraph-show-instances deep-linked to /graph?label=AgentRun as expected. Keyboard ArrowDown/Up focus navigation works.

ONTOLOGY DESIGNER (/ontology → ontology-tab-designer): ontology-draft-state read 'No draft'. Clicked ontology-create-draft → state updated to 'feature/draft-mvay0pc7 (0 changes)'. Typed 'QATestType' in ontology-field-label → ontology-add-change → ontology-change-row rendered. ontology-publish was DISABLED pre-validate (gating works). ontology-validate → ontology-verdict read 'PUBLISH_OK' + ontology-impact rendered. ontology-request-review → ontology-pr rendered. After validate ontology-publish became enabled; opening it showed typed-confirm dialog with ontology-publish-confirm-input (placeholder = exact branch name 'feature/draft-mvay0pc7'); ontology-publish-confirm stayed DISABLED when empty and when wrong-name was typed — gating correct.

IMPACT (/impact): impact-mode-toggle with all three mode buttons present. Searching 'payment' returned 4 impact-result; selecting one rendered impact-result-panel in BLAST, UPSTREAM, and WHAT-IF modes (mode switch re-ran correctly). whatif-action-remove + whatif-action-isolate present; after clicking remove, whatif-result-panel and whatif-safe-banner appeared with text 'Simulation only — nothing was changed. This models removing payments against a copy of the graph.'

REPORTS (/reports): 5 report-render buttons; clicking first rendered report-output. Schedules: schedule-recurrence is a native <select>; filled schedule-name='TEST_sched_iter5', picked recurrence+format, clicked schedule-create → schedule-row count 1→2 with schedule-notice visible; schedules-due-count badge rendered. schedule-mark-run executed; schedule-delete removed the row (2→1).

COLLABORATION (/collaboration): collaboration-missing-backend rendered with title 'Collaboration is not available in this deployment'; collab-contract-badge = 'contract · BACKEND-MISSING-016'; three alt links wired — collab-alt-share-view→/graph, collab-alt-reports→/reports, collab-alt-activity→/overview. No comment/presence UI, no network error.

BRAND (/brand): brand-editor, brand-app-name, brand-color-picker, brand-assistant-name, brand-theme-previews, all 4 contrast indicators (brand-contrast-dark/-light/-hc-dark/-hc-light) and brand-contrast-status all present. brand-contrast-status text = 'Contrast failing' (reactive to current colour). brand-publish and brand-rollback are DISABLED (BACKEND-MISSING-018, brand-publish-contract note visible). Terminology: typed 'Widget' in brand-rename-input + clicked brand-terminology-preview → brand-rename-result rendered.

TIME TRAVEL (/time): temporal-mode-toggle with 3 mode buttons; timeline-scrubber rendered; scrubber-playhead-asof visible in as-of mode. temporal-run-asof → temporal-asof-result rendered (honest empty state expected per spec note). Switching to Compare showed scrubber-handle-from + scrubber-handle-to; temporal-run-compare → temporal-compare-result rendered. Playback: searching 'service' returned 6 temporal-playback-result; selecting one rendered temporal-playback-result-panel with temporal-playback-next/-prev buttons. Snapshots: created 'TEST_snap_iter5_v2'; snapshot-restore opened typed-confirm with placeholder='TEST_snap_iter5_v2'; snapshot-restore-confirm DISABLED when empty AND when wrong text typed — gating correct.

AUTH + NAV: Signed in via pre-filled bootstrap token + signin-submit-button; all left-rail SPA links reached their routes without goto. Console errors are the previously documented harmless 401s from /auth/health + one 400 from a temporal query against empty bitemporal state (expected).

ui_bugs.issue: Pressing Escape does not close the publish-confirm dialog; only the Cancel button dismisses it. Minor UX, not blocking (gating itself works correctly).

action_items: (Optional, LOW) Add Escape-to-close handler to the OntologyDesigner publish-confirm dialog for keyboard dismissal parity with the snapshot-restore dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: Typed-confirm dialogs are consistent across Ontology publish and Snapshot restore — good. Both correctly gate the confirm button on exact-match input. Consider extracting the shared TypedConfirmDialog pattern (placeholder = expected text, confirm disabled unless input.trim() === expected) into a single component in /app/frontend/src/components/ to avoid future drift.
MetaGraph page loads 75 types with inspector + instance deep-link all under one screen — if the type list grows further, consider virtualising metagraph-types-list.
Collaboration + Brand screens use consistent BACKEND-MISSING-### contract-badge pattern — nice. Reuse this pattern for any future not-yet-available screens.
Impact what-if 'safe banner' copy is clear and reassuring; good UX for destructive-looking simulations.

success_rate.frontend: 7/7 flows pass — MetaGraph, Ontology Designer, Impact (3 modes), Reports+Schedules, Collaboration, Brand, Time Travel

test_credentials: Bearer: [REDACTED-F01] (pre-filled), tenant: default (pre-filled), submit testid: signin-submit-button.
seed_data_creation: In demo memory store: one ontology draft branch 'feature/draft-mvay0pc7' with a PUBLISH_OK validated change + an open PR (not merged); one schedule 'TEST_sched_iter5' (then deleted); two snapshots 'TEST_snap_iter5' + 'TEST_snap_iter5_v2' (not restored); no destructive publish or restore was actually executed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 new/extended flows work. IMPORTANT: the publish-confirm and snapshot-restore dialogs are overlay modals that intercept nav clicks — use the Cancel button to close them (Escape works for snapshot-restore but NOT for ontology-publish). schedule-recurrence/schedule-format are native <select> elements (use select_option). impact-search needs ~1.2s debounce. temporal-asof/compare legitimately return empty results against the in-memory store — that is expected. Session is in-memory only — click left-rail <a> links, never page.goto() authed routes.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs. Only a minor UX inconsistency: OntologyDesigner publish-confirm dialog ignores Escape key (snapshot-restore honors it). Likely missing a keydown listener or Dialog onOpenChange wiring in /app/frontend/src/components/OntologyDesigner.tsx. Mitigation: add onKeyDown Escape → close, or wrap in the same Dialog primitive used by snapshot-restore.
